claims.text: Reliance interventions for LLM users lack rigorous evaluation for appropriate reliance.
Interventions for LLM reliance reduce over-reliance.
Interventions for LLM reliance generally fail to improve appropriate reliance.
People become more confident after making wrong reliance decisions in certain contexts.
People demonstrate poor calibration when making reliance decisions in human-LLM collaboration.

evidence.description: Reliance interventions have been developed to help users of LLMs, but they lack rigorous evaluation for appropriate reliance.
Our findings indicate that while interventions reduce over-reliance...
...they generally fail to improve appropriate reliance.
Furthermore, people became more confident after making wrong reliance decisions in certain contexts...

methodologies.name: Randomized online user experiment
methodologies.description: A randomized online experiment with 400 participants using a two-step question answering process before and after receiving modified LLM advice.
conditions: LLM advice modified by one of three reliance interventions

limitations.text: Existing reliance interventions lack rigorous evaluation for appropriate reliance.
Tested interventions generally fail to improve appropriate reliance and lead to poor user calibration after wrong decisions.

future_work.text: Designing effective reliance interventions in human-LLM collaboration based on study findings.
